name: Ahithophel
bio: Ahithophel the Gilonite was David's trusted counselor, renowned for advice so sound it was regarded "as if one consulted the word of God" (2 Samuel 16:23). When Absalom launched his rebellion, he sent for Ahithophel from his hometown of Giloh while the conspiracy was gathering strength, and Ahithophel's defection to Absalom's side was a severe blow — news of it reached David as he fled Jerusalem, prompting his anguished prayer, "LORD, turn Ahithophel's counsel into foolishness" (2 Samuel 15:12, 31). Ahithophel's full role advising Absalom, and the undoing of his counsel, is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
